subject: Enclave mapping and snapshot cadence for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP audits
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Enclave mapping + snapshot cadence -- clarifying asks for Acme pre-audit

Team —

Acme has pushed our pre-audit intake forward and wants a short narrative plus artifact plan by EOD Friday. They specifically asked for:

- A concise enclave map (what we call "service enclaves") showing which products/processes live in each boundary.
- Snapshot cadence for logs/configs (they want to understand snapshot frequency and retention for FedRAMP).
- A proposed sampling plan for evidence (which days/instances we'll pull).

Questions / asks:
1) Kimberly — can you pull the current enclave export (network zones + KMS boundaries) and confirm whether the "billing" service is in the same enclave as hosted inference? If not, call out cross-enclave dependencies.
2) Olga — for snapshot cadence, Acme expects a proposed schedule for: system configuration exports, IAM role change logs, key rotation artifacts, and patch windows. They flagged they like weekly snapshots for configs and daily tokenized log snapshots for the 90-day retention window for FedRAMP. Can you validate what our platform currently supports and where we need a short-run process?
3) Jonas — we need control-owner confirmations for the ISO controls mapped to these enclaves. I've attached a CSV template (control-owner-assignments.csv) — please fill in owners for the controls tied to enclave boundaries.

Attachments: enclave-mapping-draft.v1.pdf (draft), snapshot-cadence-proposal.xlsx (initial proposal), control-owner-assignments.csv (template).

Goal: consolidate a 1-page narrative + artifact list for Acme by Friday so they can include it in the intake packet. If any ask will miss that delivery, flag now and propose a new date.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-04-20T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Enclave mapping + snapshot cadence -- clarifying asks for Acme pre-audit

Priya — quick take after a fast pass through the infra exports.

- Enclave mapping: billing is in the payments enclave, separate from hosted inference, but we have an outbound API path that sends usage aggregates to billing. I'll annotate the draft map to show the cross-enclave flow and list service owners.
- Snapshot capabilities: current platform supports weekly full-config exports (YAML) and daily aggregated logs (tokenized) for 60 days by default. For FedRAMP we can enable 90-day tokenized log snapshots and extend config export retention to 180 days; this will require a small infra policy change and an SRE runbook update.
- Key rotation artifacts: KMS rotation logs are available but not currently exported on a schedule; I propose adding a weekly KMS audit export (signed) to the snapshot plan.

I'll update enclave-mapping-draft.v1.pdf with the flow lines and create a short CHANGELOG entry for the infra policy. Estimated time: enclave map update + policy note = 4 hours. If that's acceptable I'll push an updated PDF to the Drive link and attach the control owner annotations.

--Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Infrastructure Security

From: Audits Intake <audits@acme-sec.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hollis (marta@hollis.com)
Date: 2027-04-21T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit intake: enclave map / evidence cadence — quick confirmation

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the heads-up and the initial doc list. Two quick clarifications from the Acme intake team:

1) For FedRAMP, we need an explicit statement of snapshot immutability and the chain of custody for exported artifacts. Are exports hashed and stored with attestations? If yes, provide a short paragraph describing the process.
2) For ISO 27001 scope, please confirm whether the payments enclave is in-scope or out-of-scope for the certification (we saw your note about outbound API flows). If payments is out-of-scope we need a control for boundary enforcement and a test plan demonstrating isolation.

Also — if you have a proposed sampling calendar (which days you'll run exports and which instances) please send it; the auditor wants to pre-book a remote session to observe one sample extraction next week.

Regards,
Audits Intake Team
Acme Security

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Sent: Tuesday, April 20, 2027 9:15 AM
To: Kimberly Park; Olga Petrov; Jonas Weber
Subject: Enclave mapping + snapshot cadence -- clarifying asks for Acme pre-audit

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Audits Intake <audits@acme-sec.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hollis (marta@hollis.com)
Date: 2027-04-22T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pre-audit intake: enclave map / evidence cadence — proposed answers and next steps

Hi —

Thanks for the quick review, Acme. Short answers below and next steps: 

1) Snapshot immutability and chain of custody: our export process creates a deterministic tarball, computes a SHA256 hash, and signs the manifest with a KMS-backed signing key. Export artifacts are then stored in a write-once S3 bucket with object lock enabled (governance mode) for the retention period. I'll add a 3-line artifact narrative to the one-pager.

2) ISO scope: payments enclave is currently marked out-of-scope for the ISO certification but must be included in the FedRAMP boundary assessment because of the outbound usage summary flow. We'll attach a boundary enforcement control (network ACL plus egress filtering) and the test plan to show isolation during the audit.

3) Sampling calendar: proposed sample extraction window: 
- Wednesday 2027-04-28 09:00–10:00 PT — remote observation of config export (enclave: inference-main).
- Friday 2027-04-30 02:00–03:00 PT — KMS rotation export review (signed manifest).

Kimberly and Olga — can you confirm those windows and whether the infra policy change to extend log/config retention to 90/180 days respectively will be ready by 04/27? If not, propose alternate dates.

I will attach the short narrative and updated enclave map to HubSpot-12345 once we finalize.

Best,
Priya
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: enclave-mapping-draft.v1.pdf (updated to show payment boundary), snapshot-cadence-proposal.xlsx (edited), control-owner-assignments.csv (filled where available)
